info.title: KIFARU PORTOS API
info.description:
**Kenya Intelligent Freight, Access, Routing & Unified Logistics Platform** — backend API.

* Rolling clearance (WIM pre-screen -> deterministic GREEN/AMBER/RED). The static scale remains the legal reference.
* Digital cargo passport, signed weighing tickets with QR verification, hash-chained ledger.
* Queue forecasting and slot booking, backhaul marketplace, environmental estimates (modelled).
* Every record carries `source` = `live` | `simulated` | `replay`. Simulated data is never presented as live.

post.description:
Live measurements from an edge gateway. In the cloud the gateway authenticates with an mTLS device certificate at
IoT Core and the ingest worker calls this with a service token; locally an operator token is accepted.
Generates synthetic lane passes through the full pipeline. Output is tagged source=simulated everywhere.

schema.title: Response Simulate Api V1 Weighing Simulate Post

post.description:
Record the static-scale result for an AMBER/RED pass. The static scale is the legal reference; this issues the
`static_certified` ticket and records the WIM-vs-static error for accuracy benchmarking.
Operator override (requires MFA). Only allowed when a static verification exists; the original decision is never deleted.

get.description: Public, unauthenticated verification of a QR ticket. Returns only non-sensitive fields.
